name: Barbell Incline Close-Grip Bench Press
steps: Lie on a moderately inclined bench with your feet flat and take a shoulder-width overhand grip.
Set your shoulder blades against the pad, brace and bring the bar over your shoulders.
Lower the bar smoothly to your upper chest while keeping your elbows tucked close to your sides.
Press the bar straight back up until your elbows extend fully.
tips: Keep your forearms vertical beneath the bar throughout each repetition.
Choose a close grip that keeps your wrists straight rather than bent inward.
